title: ROLECONFLICTBENCH: A BENCHMARK OF ROLE CONFLICT SCENARIOS FOR EVALUATING LLMS’ CONTEXTUAL SENSITIVITY
findings: The key finding related to religion was that most evaluated LLMs exhibit a strong preference bias. Roles associated with Abrahamic religions (Christianity, Islam, Judaism) were vastly preferred over roles from Dharmic religions, with Hinduism and especially Buddhism being the least preferred.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the preference bias of LLMs towards specific religious roles. It evaluated whether models prioritize roles associated with Abrahamic religions (Christianity, Islam, Judaism) over Dharmic religions (Hinduism, Buddhism) when presented with role-conflict scenarios.
